key.name: volume-step
key.description: Percentage of volume to increase or decrease on each knob rotation step.

key.name: active-only
key.description: When true, only applications currently emitting sound are cycled through.

key.name: hud-timeout-ms
key.description: Milliseconds the HUD switcher remains visible after knob interaction.

key.name: osd-style
key.description: Choose between native GNOME stock volume OSD ('stock') and centered custom HUD switcher ('custom').

key.name: cycle-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut or signal emitted when the knob is pressed. Single click cycles active apps; double-click/hold toggles mute.

key.name: volume-up-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut or signal emitted when the knob is rotated clockwise.

key.name: volume-down-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut or signal emitted when the knob is rotated counter-clockwise.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: When true, prints detailed stream detection and knob events to journalctl.
